) and the following answers to the questions were written for teens — not adults! Adults are working with different assumptions, have a very different knowledge base, have different life experiences (for better or for worse), and adults and teens use different words to mean different things (we do not speak the same language!). Simply put, adults and teens read things with different glasses. If the following makes sense to you and helps, great! If not, then get one of the many books written for adults.
